description:
Embed V4.0 embedding model served by Cohere.

Embed V4.0 is served by Cohere over its OpenAI-compatible API with a 128000-token context window and proxied through the UnitySVC gateway, which routes each request to the upstream and bills per token.

Reach it through the UnitySVC gateway with your own Cohere API key (the byok channel). See the code examples for setup with the OpenAI SDK, the Cohere SDK, and cURL.
name: embed-v4.0

payout_price.description: Service provider charges $0.12 / $0 per 1M input/output tokens
